metadata.title: Even Minkowski uniqueness as a consequence of logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski
metadata.description: This research note records consequences of OpenAI's recently released origin-symmetric logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski inequality. In every ambient dimension n >= 2 and for 0 <= p < 1, every smooth strictly positive even density on S^(n-1) has exactly one smooth positive even support-function solution of h^(1-p) det(∇²h+hI)=f with positive-definite curvature-radius matrix. For 0 < p < 1, identical Lp surface-area measures determine arbitrary full-dimensional origin-symmetric convex bodies. The note gives the nonsmooth first-variation and mixed-volume strictness argument explicitly and a local form of the smooth endpoint transfer of He–Liu; existence and regularity are established inputs. These results are newly available consequences of the new inequality and known reductions, not a new proof of logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski or a claim of first public announcement. Equal-volume boxes exclude arbitrary-measure uniqueness at p=0. The package contains source, analytic and priority audits, pinned dependency hashes and reproducible exact rational checks. The upstream Lean source scope was inspected, but independent kernel rebuilding, axiom extraction and Comparator reproduction were not completed; no formal verification of this follow-on theorem is claimed. AI tools were used extensively in research, drafting and verification. This preprint has not undergone conventional human peer review or refereeing at publication. Automated adversarial reviews are not human peer review.
